note: Copied from karajan-code, which holds the family's knowledge of what an injection attempt looks like. It lives there as JavaScript regexes rather than as a published catalogue, so this is a translation, not a mirror -- see KRD-TSK-0004. Every pattern here needs its own test: JavaScript and Python regexes agree on these constructs, but agreeing by inspection is not the same as agreeing.
